comment: The overtime money is nice, but I would rather sleep.
When a patient crashes on this unit, five people are in the room in thirty seconds; that is why I stay.
The handoff problems are not about people being lazy; it is the 6:45 a.m. chaos with admissions still arriving.
Beatriz is the reason our new graduates survive the first three months.
There is no path from CNA to anything here unless you figure it out alone.
The educator answers texts at 3 a.m. when she does not have to; she is the best thing about this unit.
One night charge nurse is clinically excellent and I would want that person on any code, but the tone with new graduates drives them away.
Hago horas extra casi todas las semanas y ya no me alcanza el cuerpo.
Some nights the charge nurse's mood decides whether it is a good shift or a bad one.
Two of the four vital sign machines on the unit have been broken since June.
La educadora es la única persona de liderazgo que viene a vernos de noche.
Los suministros llegan bien, pero la máquina de signos vitales del lado norte lleva semanas en reparación.
The education budget seems to exist on paper only.
A simple 'good catch' from the charge nurse would go a long way, and we get it about once a quarter.
Bedside report was announced last year and lasted about three weeks.
On days we usually have the ratio we are supposed to have, and I appreciate that.
Night to day report has gotten worse since we lost two experienced night nurses.
The agency nurses are competent but they do not know our patients or our routines, and we end up doing their orientation at 2 a.m.
Weekday staffing is usually fine; it is the weekends on nights that are not safe.
Cuando el reporte es organizado, el turno empieza bien; cuando no, pasamos la primera hora adivinando.
Las enfermeras nuevas de noche tienen miedo de preguntar porque la respuesta siempre llega con un tono de regaño.
The thank-you cards we write for each other are nice, but nothing ever comes from leadership.
Lo mejor de esta unidad son los compañeros; por ellos sigo aquí.
Tuition help for my BSN would keep me here for years.
Supplies are fine; it is the equipment repair process that takes forever.
Staffing is the reason I am looking at other hospitals.
The employee of the month board has shown the same three day-shift names for most of the year.
Llevo tres años en las noches y nunca he recibido un reconocimiento formal, aunque cubro turnos extra cada mes.
Monday to Thursday the staffing is enough; the problem is Friday and Saturday nights.
I was told the overtime was temporary in January. It is September.
I was corrected in front of a patient's family by the charge nurse in my second week; I went to my car and cried.
I have worked nights here for almost two years and I cannot remember the last time a manager said thank you for anything.
A clear written rule for weekends and holidays would end most of the arguments.
El cuarto de descanso parece un almacén; no hay dónde sentarse ni comer tranquilo.
Skills validation with the educator was the most useful hour I have had here this year.
The day CNAs are amazing and keep the shift moving.
I would like to become a charge nurse someday and I have no idea what the steps are.
The educator's pressure injury refresher changed how I do turns.
I asked for one Saturday off in four months for my daughter's quinceañera and it was denied while others get every weekend.
Float nurses from 4 East help, but they get pulled back as soon as their unit gets busy.
I feel appreciated by my coworkers, which is why I stay; from leadership, not so much.
I asked about certification reimbursement twice and got no answer; I paid for the exam myself.
One of the night charge nurses talks to new nurses like they are in trouble before they have said a word.
Quiero certificarme en enfermería médico-quirúrgica, pero nadie me explica cómo pedir el reembolso.
The schedule comes out ten days before it starts, which makes child care impossible.
El reporte al pie de la cama funcionó unas semanas y luego todos volvimos a lo de antes.
We need two more night positions filled, not more overtime sign-up sheets.
I received a patient last week with no mention of the fall the night before; I found out from the daughter.
I picked up overtime eleven times in the last two months because the alternative was leaving my coworkers short.
Gracias a la educadora aprobé mi certificación; ella sí cree en nosotros.
Every Saturday night we start with four nurses for twenty-eight patients and hope nobody gets admitted.
On days the effort does get recognized; I feel valued by my team and by the charge nurses.
El cambio de turno de las siete de la mañana es un caos y siempre se pierde información.
The break room has no window and three chairs for twenty people.
Necesitamos contratar enfermeras de noche en lugar de pagar tanta agencia.
I am a CNA covering twelve patients on nights when someone calls out, and the fall-risk patients all need two-person assists.
Siempre las mismas personas consiguen los fines de semana libres y las demás cubrimos.
I do not need a plaque, I need someone to notice when we run a full unit with four nurses and nobody falls.
New nurses on nights are afraid to ask questions because of how they get answered.
Como asistente, a veces tengo doce pacientes de noche y no puedo contestar los timbres a tiempo.
The pharmacist who rounds with us on Tuesdays has made med passes smoother for everyone.
Our unit secretary keeps the whole day shift running and we all know it.
I got my certification this year with the educator's help and the unit never mentioned it.
Day shift CNAs are the backbone of this unit and the RNs know it.
Las enfermeras de agencia ayudan, pero cada semana es una persona distinta y hay que explicarles todo.
Please look at how many admissions land between 7 p.m. and midnight; the night shift gets the surge with the smallest team.
El equipo de noche es pequeño, pero nos cuidamos unos a otros.
Me entregaron un paciente sin avisarme que tenía riesgo de caída; lo supe por la familia.
Hay una persona a cargo en las noches que trata a las enfermeras nuevas con desprecio, y por eso se van.
When something goes wrong at night we hear about it by email the next day; when something goes right nobody mentions it.
Pedí un cambio de turno con un mes de anticipación y nunca me respondieron.
Recognition is fine on days; the problem is that night shift is invisible.
Cuando hay una emergencia, todos corren a ayudar sin que nadie lo pida.
At 7 p.m. the day nurses give report from the hallway while answering call lights; we need a quiet five minutes per patient.
Handoff is better when the charge nurse protects the time; it depends on who is in charge that day.
The break room refrigerator has been leaking for months and we keep putting towels under it.
Best team I have worked with in twelve years of nursing; the problems here are not the people.
The new beds are great; the fall alarms on the old ones in 420 to 432 do not work half the time.
Me gustaría que el reconocimiento fuera para todos los turnos, no solo para el día.
Las sillas de ruedas están rotas y las alarmas de las camas viejas fallan.
A charge nurse development program would be a reason to stay.
Beatriz me enseñó más en dos semanas que todo mi programa de orientación anterior.
I precepted two new hires this year and it was never acknowledged, not even a line in the newsletter.
Skills days are good when they happen; they happened once this year.
Requests are approved based on who you are, not when you asked.
I am in nursing school and nobody on the unit has asked how they can support it.
Cuando hacemos un buen trabajo de noche nadie se entera; cuando falta algo, todos se enteran.
We cover each other's lunches without being asked.
I like bedside report when we do it, because the patient corrects us on the spot.
A printed handoff sheet with a fixed order would fix half of the misses I see.
Si hubiera autoprogramación como en otras unidades, muchos nos quedaríamos.
Las clases de la educadora son lo único que me hace sentir que estoy creciendo.
The night crew is small but we have each other's backs.
Last month a patient's family wrote a letter about the night team and we only found out because the unit secretary showed us.
The same people get every holiday off and the same people get every weekend; look at the last six months.
The 7 a.m. handoff is a race: the night nurse wants to leave and the day nurse is already getting assignments, so things get missed.
Call-outs on Friday night are predictable; the response should be too.
When I work my third twelve in a row I know my judgment is not what it should be, and nobody asks.
Como asistente de enfermería, siento que no hay futuro aquí a menos que me vaya.
Recognition on this unit happens at 10 a.m. staff meetings that night shift never attends, so it goes to the same day people every time.
Un simple gracias del gerente después de una noche difícil valdría más que cualquier tarjeta de regalo.
I have seen two orientees request day shift to get away from a certain charge nurse.
Posting the schedule late hurts the people with kids most.
Even on the worst weekend nights, nobody leaves until the last patient is settled.
Our educator is shared with 4 East and still finds time for every orientee; she should be full-time here.
Beatriz never makes you feel stupid for asking.
Los fines de semana de noche estamos siempre cortos de personal y nadie lo soluciona.
Rotating us from nights to days with one day in between is not safe.
A working ice machine on the unit would save us ten trips a shift.
I love my coworkers; I just wish the system gave us a fair chance.
New people get welcomed on days; the CNAs especially make orientation easier.
Scheduling on days is reasonably fair in my experience.
The intimidation is not loud; it is the sighing and the eye roll when you ask for help.
One night charge nurse is kind and overloaded; the contrast with the other one is hard on everyone.
Self-scheduling was promised when I was hired; we still get a schedule posted with no input.
The mock code the educator ran in April made me feel ready for the real one in July.
La educadora siempre nos dice lo que hacemos bien; ojalá la gerencia hiciera lo mismo.
Report between CNAs does not exist; we figure out who is a fall risk from the whiteboards, if they were updated.
Marcus thanks people by name at the end of his shifts and it makes a difference.
We share one working bladder scanner with 4 East and it is never on our side at night.
